import type { JSX } from '@solidjs/web';
import { type DateRangeValue, type ValueChangeDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { type DateModeProps } from '../../internal/date';
export interface CalendarTranslations {
    previousMonth: string;
    nextMonth: string;
    today: string;
    clear: string;
    cancel: string;
    confirm: string;
    selected: string;
    unavailable: string;
    adjacentMonth: string;
    dateLabel: string;
    visibleDayLabel: string;
    monthLabel: string;
    startLabel: string;
    endLabel: string;
    weekdays: readonly string[];
    weekdayShort: readonly string[];
    months: readonly string[];
}
interface Base {
    id?: string;
    label?: JSX.Element;
    'aria-label'?: string;
    'aria-labelledby'?: string;
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    referenceDate?: string;
    today?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
    locale?: 'ko-KR' | 'en-US';
    translations?: Partial<CalendarTranslations>;
    onCancel?: () => void;
}
export type CalendarProps = Base & (DateModeProps extends infer P ? P extends {
    mode?: 'single';
} ? P & {
    onConfirm?: (detail: ValueChangeDetails<string | null>) => void;
} : P & {
    onConfirm?: (detail: ValueChangeDetails<DateRangeValue>) => void;
} : never);
export declare function Calendar(props: CalendarProps): JSX.Element;
export {};
